description: This file defines a Backup class for handling backup and restore operations in the Notesnook project, including exporting, importing, migrating, and verifying backups, with support for encryption, compression, and legacy formats.

classes.name: Backup
classes.description: Class providing methods for exporting, importing, migrating, and verifying backups in the Notesnook application.

methods.name: lastBackupTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last backup from the database key-value store.

methods.name: updateBackupTime
methods.description: Updates the last backup timestamp in the database key-value store.

methods.name: exportLegacy
methods.description: Exports legacy backups in unencrypted or encrypted format, supporting chunked data export.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports current backups, supporting full or partial modes, with optional encryption.

methods.name: backupCollection
methods.description: Streams and buffers collection items for backup, handling chunking.

methods.name: bufferToFile
methods.description: Converts buffered data into a backup file chunk, applying compression and encryption as needed.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Imports a backup file, handling decryption, decompression, and data migration.

methods.name: migrateBackup
methods.description: Adjusts backup data to match current application version, handling legacy formats.

methods.name: migrateData
methods.description: Migrates backup data items to current database schema, handling item-specific transformations.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the structure and essential fields of a backup file.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of backup data against its stored hash.
